computed: strict reproduction of the six Phase-51 center-launch CSE/non-CSE evaluator records
deterministic Phase-51 saddle and launch-node reconstruction at lambda 0, 0.5, and 1 for both frozen sources solely to recreate those six evaluator states
runtime dtype tracing of every generated CSE temporary and every raw output before coercion
staged m4-gradient, lifted-basis, m5-gradient, lambda-blend, A_lambda.T contraction, and outer-conjugation ledgers
direct same-expression SymPy-evalf references with mpmath stage algebra at 80 and 120 decimal digits
default joint-CSE, default non-CSE, long-namespace joint-CSE, and long-namespace element-local CSE variants
one static candidate assessment under the unchanged Phase-51 5e-10 RHS threshold
not_computed: any Gamma--K root, nonlinear K-flow ODE, trajectory, endpoint, tangent, orientation, or continuation rerun; the six explicitly allowed local saddle/node reconstructions are input recreation rather than new root evidence
a retroactive rewrite of the immutable Phase-51 manifest, runner, or raw result
cross-platform long-double portability or a formal endpoint error bound
other roots, charts, arms, cap reintersections, components, Stokes data, ends, determinant lines, cutoff or continuum limits, global cycles, or physics claims

representative_float64_temporaries: constant prefactors and constant transcendental subexpressions

disclosed_feasibility_pilots.selection_role: The pilots localized a concrete runtime-dtype and cancellation mechanism and selected the element-local candidate family. They did not evaluate that candidate at all six frozen slots, did not alter the inherited 5e-10 gate, and are not authoritative evidence.
disclosed_feasibility_pilots.post_pilot_freeze: Every slot, variant, precision, stage, metric, threshold, and classification below is fixed before an authoritative Phase-52 runner or result is committed.

corrections: allow the six deterministic Phase-51 saddle/node reconstructions required because the raw result does not serialize the six launch-state vectors
make every exact, reproduction, reference, trace, telescope, dtype, and global-guard prerequisite conjunctive before the supported classification
treat long-namespace joint-CSE accuracy as a diagnostic negative control while retaining its raw dtype contract as mandatory
identify the gradient-to-reference threshold as a new Phase-52 gate rather than a Phase-51 inheritance
freeze the exact runtime and extended-precision representation needed to interpret temporary dtype counts
pre_runner_design_audit.history_policy: The original manifest-introduction commit is preserved; these corrections occur in a separate pre-runner commit and no authoritative value has been observed.

pre_runner_symbolic_identity_audit.observation: The pinned executable models expand sums containing 50-digit SymPy Float constants before differentiation, whereas the repair differentiates source elements before their fixed-order sum. Those mathematically equivalent construction orders leave nonzero symbolic Float-rounding residuals near 1e-48 to 1e-47, so literal exact equality to the already-rounded expanded Float tree is not a valid exact algebraic predicate.
pre_runner_symbolic_identity_audit.correction: Prove the element-sum/global-gradient identity on a separate exact-decimal Rational reconstruction of the same declared source equation, boundary values, coordinate scales, and source deltas. Keep the executable repair on the pinned 50-digit Float model, retain its Float construction-order residual as a diagnostic rather than calling it exact, and arbitrate its actual numerical accuracy only against the frozen 80/120-digit same-model references at all six slots.
pre_runner_symbolic_identity_audit.selection_and_threshold_policy: No authoritative slot value was evaluated. The executable candidate, six slots, element order, accumulation order, reference tiers, and every numerical threshold remain unchanged; this correction removes an impossible category error from the exact symbolic check rather than weakening a numerical gate.
pre_runner_symbolic_identity_audit.history_policy: Both earlier manifest commits and the failed validate-only diagnostic are preserved. The manifest is repinned once more before the runner is committed.

phase49_manifest.role: raw-output dtype guard and complete-flow clongdouble precedent

slots.state: Exactly the Phase-51 declared_center_launch_initial_state recomputed from its byte-pinned source context: saddle_w + radius*(launch_w@chart.center).

runtime_contract.policy: Any version, dtype representation, generated replacement count, or callable-source fingerprint drift makes the run INVALID rather than changing the expected temporary ledger.

evaluator_variants.baseline_joint_CSE: The byte-identical Phase-51 joint canonical CSE over gradient plus Hessian with the default NumPy lambdify namespace.
evaluator_variants.baseline_nonCSE: The byte-identical Phase-51 unreduced gradient with the default NumPy lambdify namespace and no replacement list or cache.
evaluator_variants.long_namespace_joint_CSE: The same joint canonical CSE, but use a dedicated SymPy NumPy printer that emits every Float and non-integer Rational from decimal text as np.clongdouble, binds pi from an 80-digit decimal string, and wraps sqrt and exp so every scalar input and return is np.clongdouble. Integer powers remain structural integer exponents. No post-output upcast may count as retention.

element_local_long_CSE.construction: Before global expansion, substitute the frozen source and coordinate scales into each of the four m4 or five m5 midpoint elements, differentiate every element separately, run canonical CSE separately on each element-gradient vector, evaluate every Float, non-integer Rational, pi, sqrt, exp, temporary, and raw output through the dedicated clongdouble printer/namespace, and sum element contributions componentwise in the fixed left-to-right element order with clongdouble accumulation.
element_local_long_CSE.exact_identity: On an exact-decimal Rational reconstruction of the declared source equation, boundary values, coordinate scales, and source deltas, the symbolic sum of element gradients must equal the globally expanded gradient componentwise. The executable candidate remains the pinned 50-digit SymPy Float construction; its nonzero construction-order rounding residual is retained explicitly and is not mislabeled as an exact identity.
element_local_long_CSE.flow_boundary: Keep the lifted-basis transform, lambda blend, A_lambda.T contraction, and outer minus-conjugation in clongdouble. No complex128 cast is performed in this static phase.

prohibited: post-output clongdouble coercion counted as proof of raw temporary dtype
hidden Python float or NumPy float64 CSE temporaries in either repaired candidate
a favorable slot, precision, element order, summation order, backend, threshold, or reference selected after output
using a repaired value to rewrite the Phase-51 raw result

runtime_dtype_audit.method: Use Python tracing at each generated callable return to inspect every local CSE temporary before frame destruction; separately inspect every raw output scalar before np.asarray coercion.
runtime_dtype_audit.required_repair_contract: Every runtime CSE temporary and raw gradient output in both repaired variants must be NumPy complex256/clongdouble at all six slots. Trace completeness must equal the generated replacement count. This dtype condition is mandatory for both variants; long-namespace joint-CSE reference accuracy remains a diagnostic negative control and is not required for the primary element-local classification.

reference.backend: Direct SymPy evalf at the active precision over the same pinned source-substituted expanded gradients, with input substitutions built from mp-preserving decimal strings and all matrix products and conjugation retained in mpmath. NumPy lambdify, Python float literals, and native evaluator outputs are forbidden in the authoritative reference.
reference.input_lift: Round-trip every NumPy longdouble real and imaginary component through a unique 25-digit scientific decimal string; require exact NumPy longdouble round-trip before constructing mp.mpf/mp.mpc.
reference.independence_boundary: This reference independently evaluates the same symbolic expressions and arithmetic stages; it tests evaluator arithmetic, not the physical correctness of the finite model.
reference.CSE_control: At each tier evaluate the canonical replacement DAG directly with SymPy evalf substitutions and compare it with direct unreduced-expression evalf. Neither path may use lambdify, Python float conversion, or native NumPy outputs.

metrics.retained_absolute: normwise and maximum-component absolute differences are retained at every stage
metrics.cancellation_index: sum of absolute term contributions divided by the absolute completed component, with 1e-100 floor
metrics.telescope: Retain the closed baseline-to-candidate and candidate-to-reference vector differences at every declared stage; outer conjugation must add no unexplained error.

thresholds.threshold_policy: The RHS 5e-10 gate is inherited without weakening from Phase 51. The gradient-to-reference 5e-10 gate is a new Phase-52 intermediate-arithmetic guard, chosen at the same scale after the disclosed feasibility pilot and before the authoritative six-slot result. Decimal reference gates leave at least forty digits above the 80-dps floor. No observed authoritative result may change a threshold.

classification.invalid_run_prerequisites: Manifest/source/runtime/pin/self-digest drift, duplicate or nonfinite JSON, exact symbolic identity failure, CSE back-substitution or trace incompleteness, repaired raw dtype failure, convention drift, or global-null guard failure is INVALID_RUN and cannot select a scientific classification.
scientific_prerequisites_for_supported_o: all six Phase-51 evaluator records reproduce within the frozen absolute tolerance
the baseline hidden-float64 violation reproduces with the frozen m4/m5 counts
the direct 80/120-digit reference and its high-precision CSE/non-CSE control are complete and stable
both repaired variants satisfy the mandatory temporary and raw-output clongdouble dtype contract
the staged telescope closes under its frozen tolerance
the classification and every local/global null guard are exact

run_semantics.repository_writes_during_calculation: Only the canonical result JSON may be written by the committed runner; production scratch stdout/stderr are external capture artifacts.
run_semantics.next_step_if_repair_supported: Freeze a separate Phase-53 runner that replaces the production gradient path, replays the three paired trajectories, and reruns the complete Phase-51 continuation/reflection/FD/tangent/endpoint/ledger suite without weakening any gate.
run_semantics.boundary: A static same-platform arithmetic repair is neither a root result, a continuation result, a portable backend theorem, a global intersection, a physical cycle, a TOE, nor a physics claim.
